[[:{{{2}}}|{{color|{{{1}}}|{{{3|{{{2}}}}}}}}]]<noinclude>

Based on Wikipedia's [[wikipedia:Template:Colored link|colored link template]].
==Usage==
<pre>
{{colored link|color|Page|Link text (if different from page title; optional)}}
</pre>
<code>cl</code> can be used instead of <code>colored link</code>.
See [[Help:Color]] for more info on colors.
